newsitem.title: USA: Mexico content to let peso float freely - Gil Diaz.
newsitem.headline: Mexico content to let peso float freely - Gil Diaz.

text.p: Francisco Gil Diaz, Deputy Governor of the Bank of Mexico said on Friday that the central bank had no target level for the peso and would allow the currency to float freely.
"We are not trying to make the peso appreciate or depreciate, we are tyring to let it float freely," Gil Diaz told reporters after a conference.
Gil Diaz said Mexico's monetary base was below target due to seasonal factors, but said it would end the year close to the ceiling.
He said the central bank did not have a target for the monetary base in 1997.
"We are neither restricting nor stimulating the economy. We are following a neutral stance," Gil Diaz said.
Gil Diaz also said talks with the International Monetary Fund for an Extended Fund Facility were on track.
